Interface VirtualServer

All Known Subinterfaces:
ServerProxy
All Known Implementing Classes:
RmiServerProxy, SocketServerProxy
public interface VirtualServer
Client-side abstraction of the server. Implemented by RmiServerProxy and SocketServerProxy.

The client controller calls these methods to send actions to the server; the proxy handles serialization and transport transparently.
